records.food: Named foods with <=5 g available CHO/100 g
records.limitations: Published low-carbohydrate default50, applied only to reviewed named compositions <=5 g available CHO/100g. This cutoff is a project rule, not a validated scientific threshold. Explicit AFCD commercial soy sauce and AFCD tahini plus complete Maille Dijon label are allowed, not all brands or pastes. No flour/sugar/honey/syrup or composition-unknown food.

records.food: Published assignment for low-carbohydrate vegetables, not measured food GI
records.limitations: Coding estimate only. Application to named fresh herbs, sprouts and alliums is an explicit project interpretation. It does not establish a physiological maximum or a one-unit uncertainty bound. Not a default for seed spices, flour, sauces or stock.

records.food: Frozen green peas heated in microwave, McCain Australia
records.location: Supplement1 row1798 p120; 10 healthy adults, glucose2h
records.limitations: Named human food/preparation comparator applied as explicit LOW analogy. Not measured meal GI or a biological uncertainty bound; SEM/SD not a recipe range.

records.food: Fixed weighed culinary ground spice, seed or vanilla extract
records.location: Explicit project extension of coding default, not directly published for these foods
records.limitations: Own project extension of coding default, not measured food GI or directly published Schakel scope. Full composition and consumed grams mandatory; <=0.5 g CHO each and <=1 g aggregate per serving. Includes named vanilla extract, dried herbs and whole seed garnish. Excludes flour, baking powder, bulk paste, sugar, unknown extraction and sticks/pods. No biological error bound. USDA total-carbohydrate minus fibre is a disclosed available-CHO proxy; endogenous polyols unquantified, not asserted zero. This additional proxy use awaits owner method approval.
